body: This receipt confirms that the person named below received the handbook edition named below and had an opportunity to review it and ask questions. Signing acknowledges receipt and opportunity to review, not agreement with every policy.
sections.heading: Receipt statement

body: Describe where the handbook is kept, how to ask questions, and the due date for return. Keep language identical for all employees in the same version cycle.
sections.heading: Where to find the handbook and ask questions

body: Record facts only: who was present, what was provided, what was said, what was offered, what was declined. Do not record opinions or motives.

sections.heading: Refusal record

body: File with signed receipts for the same version. Log on the refusal log sheet. Consult counsel on any further action. This is a process tool, not legal advice; confirm e-signature and retention practice with counsel.
sections.heading: Filing and next steps

body: State the new version code, effective date, what changed in plain language by section, where to find the handbook, how to sign, the due date, and where to ask questions. Use identical text for all recipients.
sections.heading: Announcement

body: List each changed section with a one-sentence practical description. Avoid vague wording such as updated policies.
sections.heading: What changed

body: Confirm each line with date and initials.
